retrieved_evidence.title: Billing navigation guide
retrieved_evidence.content: Billing navigation guide. Download invoices from Settings > Billing > Invoices. The account owner can update payment methods under Settings > Billing > Payment methods. To cancel a subscription, go to Settings > Billing > Manage subscription > Cancel subscription. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current paid billing period, and access remains available until then. Cancellation does not automatically issue a refund.

retrieved_evidence.title: Troubleshoot a failed payment
retrieved_evidence.content: If a payment fails, the account owner can update the payment method under Settings > Billing > Payment methods. After updating the payment method, select Retry payment if that option appears. If payment still fails, contact the card issuer or ask CloudDesk support for help. Do not enter full card details in a support message.
